caption: The drawing features three objects arranged on a plain, light background. At the upper left is an ornate parasol shown from above, predominantly colored in intricate black lace patterns with delicate, decorative details; its handle is a short, light beige or ivory color. Below and slightly to the center, a second view of the same parasol is depicted from underneath, illustrating the internal framework with metal spokes and a light purple or lavender fabric bordered by black lace trim, and the same beige handle visible. On the right side of the composition, the parasol's handle is shown separately in a vertical position, rendered in cream or ivory tones with carved decorative patterns, revealing a pointed metal tip at one end. The objects are detailed, with attention to the textures and structure of the lace and handle, and are laid out without overlapping, each distinctly visible.
title: Carriage Sunshade
